children: Moleculin secured a Mexican patent for its lung-targeted liposomal Annamycin and reported ATM share sales and a reduced warrant exercise price.
Mexican Patent No. 436849 granted, protecting Moleculin's lung-targeted liposomal Annamycin technology through Nov 23, 2040.
Patent strengthens global IP estate for Annamycin, supporting potential pulmonary and broader oncology development opportunities.
Moleculin sold 888,400 shares via its ATM in September 2026, raising $0.48 million in gross proceeds.
Following ATM issuances, common shares outstanding total 20,385,780.
Series I Warrant exercise price reduced from $0.75 to $0.51 per share due to anti-dilution provisions after the ATM sales.
